episodes.summary: Mr. Burns goes undercover as "Fred" at the nuclear power plant and becomes friends with Homer and the gang. Burns implements all sorts of amenities to improve his employees' lives, but a jealous Smithers plots to bring the old, bitter Burns back and destroy Fred.

episodes.name: I, Carumbus
episodes.summary: At a museum exhibit of Ancient Rome, Marge and Homer get into an argument about Homer's lack of ambition. They then imagine a Roman version of what would happen if Homer was more career-driven.

episodes.name: Now Museum, Now You Don't
episodes.summary: Lisa stays home from school to explore the wonders of Western art. She appears as Lisanardo, while Bart takes the shape of a French impressionist, Homer and Marge as Diego Rivera and Frida Kahlo, and Maggie as a warrior Cupid.

episodes.name: Treehouse of Horror XXXI
episodes.summary: Don't miss the annual terror-themed trilogy, including a frightening look at the 2020 election, parodies of Pixar and Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse and a ninth birthday Lisa just can't get over.

episodes.name: The 7 Beer Itch
episodes.summary: When Marge and the kids take a seaside vacation, Homer is unwittingly tempted by a British femme fatale.

episodes.name: Podcast News
episodes.summary: Grampa is accused of a crime. Meanwhile, Kent Brockman questions his career.

episodes.name: Three Dreams Denied
episodes.summary: Bart becomes a voiceover actor and Comic Book Guy is humiliated at Comic-Con. Meanwhile, Lisa is set up for a fall.

episodes.name: The Road To Cincinnati
episodes.summary: Odd couple Skinner and Chalmers embark on an 800-mile car ride to Cincinnati to attend an administrator's convention - but can they reach their destination without killing each other first.

episodes.name: Sorry Not Sorry
episodes.summary: Lisa calls her teacher, Ms. Hoover, a hack and refuses to apologize. Then, she learns Ms. Hoover's private pain.

episodes.name: A Springfield Summer Christmas for Christmas
episodes.summary: A cable channel films a Christmas movie in Springfield and Skinner falls in love.

episodes.name: The Dad-Feelings Limited
episodes.summary: Comic Book Guy and his wife Kumiko debate having a baby and we learn his awesome origin story.

episodes.name: Diary Queen
episodes.summary: Bart finds his old teacher's diary and learns a surprising secret. Then, Lisa discovers an even bigger surprise.

episodes.name: Wad Goals
episodes.summary: Bart becomes a successful caddy, but Marge worries it is ruining his character.

episodes.name: Yokel Hero
episodes.summary: Cletus becomes a singing sensation, while Homer becomes a new man. Then, Cletus turns on his fans, ruining everything.

episodes.name: Do PizzaBots Dream of Electric Guitars?
episodes.summary: Homer tries to reunite a mechanical band from his youth, but film and TV creator J.J. Abrams gets ahold of them first.

episodes.name: Manger Things
episodes.summary: A secret from Flanders' past is revealed; a never-before-seen room in the Simpson home.

episodes.name: Uncut Femmes
episodes.summary: We learn that Chief Wiggum's wife is more than she seems. Meanwhile, Marge takes part in a jewel heist.

episodes.name: Burger Kings
episodes.summary: Mr. Burns gets into the plant-based burger business. Lisa refuses to believe he's up to no good.

episodes.name: Panic On The Streets Of Springfield
episodes.summary: Lisa gets an imaginary friend who makes her feel much better about her friends. Meanwhile, Homer gets a vehicle with awesome torque.

episodes.name: Mother and Child Reunion
episodes.summary: Lisa makes a shocking college decision, wounding Marge. It leads to a very surprising place.

episodes.name: The Man from G.R.A.M.P.A.
episodes.summary: A British secret agent comes to Springfield in search of a Russian spy.

episodes.name: The Last Barfighter
episodes.summary: After Moe breaks their most sacred rule, a secret society of bartenders seeks ultimate vengeance on Homer and his friends.

episodes.name: The Star of the Backstage
episodes.summary: A musical comes to life in Springfield as Marge stages a revival of her beloved high school show - but her wonderful memories are threatened by the return of a rival from the past.

episodes.name: Bart's in Jail
episodes.summary: When Grampa falls victim to a phone scammer, the Simpsons set out on a mission of vengeance to get his money back.

episodes.name: Treehouse of Horror XXXII
episodes.summary: Bong Joon-ho's "Parasite," Bambi's revenge and much, much more are featured.

episodes.name: The Wayz We Were
episodes.summary: Evergreen Terrace is overrun with traffic and Moe has a fateful choice to make.

episodes.name: Lisa's Belly
episodes.summary: Marge puts a hurtful word in Lisa's brain and Bart gets swole.

episodes.name: A Serious Flanders Part One
episodes.summary: When a ruthless debt collector comes to Springfield, Homer and Ned's lives are sucked into the artfully violent world of prestige TV.

episodes.name: A Serious Flanders Part Two
episodes.summary: Things for Ned and Homer go from bad to gosh-darn worse as their prestige crime thriller nightmare continues.

episodes.name: Portrait of a Lackey on Fire
episodes.summary: Smithers finds true love with a famous fashion designer, but will his new relationship destroy Springfield? Find out.

episodes.name: Mothers and Other Strangers
episodes.summary: Teenage Homer and Grampa go on a road trip to ease their sorrow.

episodes.name: A Made Maggie
episodes.summary: Fat Tony becomes Godfather to Maggie Simpson.

episodes.name: The Longest Marge
episodes.summary: Marge and Mr. Burns fight for soul of a brash young football prodigy.

episodes.name: Pixelated and Afraid
episodes.summary: When Homer and Marge are lost in an icy wilderness, they must push themselves to their limits to survive.

episodes.name: Boyz N The Highlands
episodes.summary: Bart, Martin and the bullies are on the run for their lives when a wilderness weekend takes a chilling turn.

episodes.name: You Won't Believe What This Episode is About - Act Three Will Shock You!
episodes.summary: When Homer is erroneously blamed for leaving Santa's Little Helper locked in a hot car, footage of the incident goes viral, outraging all of Springfield and making Homer a pariah.

episodes.name: Bart the Cool Kid
episodes.summary: When Bart befriends a famous kid influencer who owns an ultra-cool skate wear brand, Homer leads a rebellion of loser dads against them.

episodes.name: Pretty Whittle Liar
episodes.summary: Cletus discovers that his wife Brandine has been hiding a secret love.. of learning.

episodes.name: The Sound of Bleeding Gums
episodes.summary: Lisa meets the son of the late musician Bleeding Gums Murphy - and attempts to improve his life.

episodes.name: My Octopus and a Teacher
episodes.summary: Bart can't control his feelings when he gets a new teacher. Meanwhile, Lisa befriends an octopus.

episodes.name: Girls Just Shauna Have Fun
episodes.summary: When Lisa joins the high school marching band, she finds an unlikely mentor in Shauna Chalmers. Meanwhile, Homer becomes a craft beer brewer.

episodes.name: Marge the Meanie
episodes.summary: A surprise from Marge's past has her bonding with Bart and terrifying Homer.

episodes.name: Meat Is Murder
episodes.summary: Grampa finds himself in a pickle when his hidden hamburger past comes back to "ketchup" with him.

episodes.name: Poorhouse Rock
episodes.summary: After Bart humiliates him at church, Homer finally teaches his son to admire his dad - until a visit from a magical, singing janitor changes everything they thought they knew.

episodes.name: Habeas Tortoise
episodes.summary: After Homer humiliates himself in a town meeting, he looks for acceptance in an internet group hunting for a missing tortoise but finds something much more sinister.

episodes.name: One Angry Lisa
episodes.summary: Lisa gets called for jury duty while Marge becomes obsessed with her exercise bike.

episodes.name: Lisa the Boy Scout
episodes.summary: When the Boy Explorers become co-ed, Bart and Lisa vow to "out scout" each other at the annual jamboree.

episodes.name: The King of Nice
episodes.summary: Marge is hired as a segment producer on Krusty's new daytime talk show. But her initial excitement about the job fades when she discovers what an endless nightmare it is.

episodes.name: Treehouse of Horror Presents Not It
episodes.summary: In this "Treehouse of Horror" Halloween episode.. Homer and his teenaged friends are pursued by a killer clown in a spoof of Stephen King's novel "It".

episodes.name: Treehouse of Horror XXXIII
episodes.summary: In a book-themed trilogy, Marge's resentment takes monstrous form, Lisa tries to save the planet through murder and Homer learns he's not the man he thought he was.

episodes.name: From Beer to Paternity
episodes.summary: Homer teaches Duffman on how to be a better father.

episodes.name: Step Brother from the Same Planet
episodes.summary: Homer has a rival in Grampa's love in a "Step Brothers" scenario.

episodes.name: When Nelson Met Lisa
episodes.summary: A future tale of the will-they-won't-they-I-guess-they-won't-maybe-they-will of Springfield's most unlikely couple.

episodes.name: Game Done Changed
episodes.summary: When Bart discovers a profitable glitch in an online game, he ropes Principal Skinner into his lucrative criminal enterprise. Meanwhile Marge and Maggie discover paradise.

episodes.name: Top Goon
episodes.summary: When Coach Moe recruits the world's greatest brawlers to teach Nelson the art of hockey goonery, Simpsons fans are enraged by a second hockey episode in 35 years.

episodes.name: My Life as a Vlog
episodes.summary: Through a series of YouTube recommended videos, the story of the rise and fall of The Simpson Family Vlog is revealed.

episodes.name: The Many Saints of Springfield
episodes.summary: Flanders goes to work for Fat Tony.

episodes.name: Carl Carlson Rides Again
episodes.summary: When Carl is smitten by a beautiful black woman, he looks into the roots of his own identity by discovering the origins of a mysterious rodeo buckle.

episodes.name: Bartless
episodes.summary: When Bart's latest prank leads to chaos at Springfield Elementary, Marge and Homer dream of a world in which their rambunctious son was never a Simpson.

episodes.name: Hostile Kirk Place
episodes.summary: By fanning the flames of hate and division instead of embracing historical fact, nobody Kirk Van Houten rises from obscurity to become arbiter of Springfield Elementary's curriculum--leading to a fascist, dystopian future where Kirk is Springfield's dictator.

episodes.name: Pin Gal
episodes.summary: A mysterious figure from Marge's past returns to coach her for a bowling tournament.

episodes.name: Fan-ily Feud
episodes.summary: Homer publicly disparages a pop singer and faces the ire of her vindictive and highly organized fan army.

episodes.name: Write Off This Episode
episodes.summary: When Marge and Lisa start a charity together, Marge is seduced by the money and prestige of Big Charity fundraising

episodes.name: The Very Hungry Caterpillars
episodes.summary: When a plague of insects shuts down Springfield, the Simpsons face their greatest challenge yet.. spending time in lockdown with each other.

episodes.name: Clown V. Board of Education
episodes.summary: Krusty opens a school for clowning, and it becomes the most successful thing he's ever done.

episodes.name: Homer's Adventures Through the Windshield Glass
episodes.summary: Time stands still after Homer crashes his car and flies through the windshield. As his life flashes before his eyes, a magical friend helps Homer learn the secret truth about his marriage.

episodes.name: Homer's Crossing
episodes.summary: Feeling worthless at work, Homer volunteers to be a school crossing guard. But when his safety squad receives too much funding, the crossing guards become a force to be feared.

episodes.name: A Mid-Childhood Night's Dream
episodes.summary: Marge feels an overwhelming dread of the empty nest.

episodes.name: McMansion & Wife
episodes.summary: When a new neighbor showers him with kindness, Homer thinks he's being tricked into buying a sports car at the dealership where the neighbor works, but the truth turns out to be even more sinister; Lisa neutralizes Nelson after he goes on a bullying spree.

episodes.name: Thirst Trap: A Corporate Love Story
episodes.summary: In a parody documentary, a young college-dropout CEO embraces the Silicon Valley "fake it until you make it" philosophy and bewitches Mr. Burns into funding her highly dubious dream project.

episodes.name: Treehouse of Horror XXXIV
episodes.summary: Bart is turned into an NFT and Marge must fight through the Blockchain to rescue him; Lisa turns to a murderer from her past; an outbreak transforms Springfielders into a plague of lazy, beer-loving oafs.

episodes.name: Iron Marge
episodes.summary: When Marge's heart is broken by a bad birthday present, Bart and Lisa must dig into their mom's past to show that they really know her. Homer becomes a neighborhood fear-monger.

episodes.name: It's a Blunderful Life
episodes.summary: Lisa recounts the story of how Homer was scapegoated for a power outage that plunged Springfield into darkness days before Thanksgiving.

episodes.name: Ae Bonny Romance
episodes.summary: When Groundskeeper Willie is kidnapped to Scotland, Bart and the Simpsons follow - only to discover that what awaits is Homer's worst nightmare.

episodes.name: Murder, She Boat
episodes.summary: Lisa must solve a closed-boat mystery when Comic Book Guy's million-dollar action figure is "murdered" on a pop culture cruise.

episodes.name: Do The Wrong Thing
episodes.summary: Homer and Bart become kings of the blue-collar sports circuit, but Marge suspects something dishonest at the core of their father-son bond.

episodes.name: Frinkenstein's Monster
episodes.summary: Professor Frink believes he's created a monster when he helps Homer land a high-level position at a state-of-the-art nuclear plant in Shelbyville.

episodes.name: Lisa Gets an F1
episodes.summary: Lisa feels a need for speed as well a need for control of her anxiety when she becomes a pro kid go-cart racer.

episodes.name: Clan of the Cave Mom
episodes.summary: A parenting disagreement between Marge and Luann Van Houten escalates into a life-or-death struggle for survival.

episodes.name: Night of the Living Wage
episodes.summary: Marge gets a job in a high-pressure ghost kitchen, but when she tries to start a union, she gets more than she collectively bargained for.

episodes.name: Cremains of the Day
episodes.summary: When someone in Homer's life passes away, he and guys from Moe's go on a road trip to scatter the ashes... but will their friendship die as well?

episodes.name: The Tell-Tale Pants
episodes.summary: Marge comes upon a surprising windfall and, angry with Homer, spends it secretly on herself.

episodes.name: The Tipping Point
episodes.summary: Homer loses his mind over tipping culture run amok.

episodes.name: Bart's Brain
episodes.summary: Bart makes a new friend.

episodes.name: Bart's Birthday
episodes.summary: Bart celebrates a birthday that will change his life forever.

episodes.name: The Yellow Lotus
episodes.summary: The Simpsons will encounter a death while on vacation at a high-end resort.

episodes.name: Desperately Seeking Lisa
episodes.summary: Lisa has a blazing misadventure in the dark world of Capital City's downtown art scene.

episodes.name: Shoddy Heat
episodes.summary: An unearthed corpse opens up a cold case from Springfield in the 1980s.. as well as a steamy relationship between young Grampa and Agnes Skinner.

episodes.name: Treehouse of Horror XXXV
episodes.summary: Giant monsters created by political rage threaten to tear the town apart, a Victorian Mr. Burns is jump-scared on Thanksgiving by the ghosts of his abused workers, and Homer bonds with a pair of extra-terrestrial jeans in an unforgettable stop-motion adventure that can only be called.. Denim.

episodes.name: Women in Shorts
episodes.summary: Girls just want to have funny.

episodes.name: Treehouse of Horror Presents: Simpsons Wicked This Way Comes
episodes.summary: A tattooed man at a mysterious night circus transports Lisa into three strange stories from the innocent 1950s, the chilling retro-present, and a brutalist future where prestige TV rules the world.

episodes.name: Convenience Airways
episodes.summary: The Simpsons are trapped on a flight with the most unruly passengers in America.

episodes.name: Homer and Her Sisters
episodes.summary: After a fight in an escape room, Krusty's truth-telling Aunt fixes Homer's relationship with Patty and Selma.

episodes.name: The Man Who Flew Too Much
episodes.summary: The new and improved Pin Pals travel to Capital City for their first ever state bowling championship.

episodes.name: Bottle Episode
episodes.summary: Marge and Smithers team up to become wine-forging Robin Hoods.

episodes.name: The Flandshees of Innersimpson
episodes.summary: Bart dips his toe into the world of celebrity DJ-ing, and Homer finally pushes Flanders too far .

episodes.name: The Last Man Expanding
episodes.summary: Springfield becomes hooked on a miracle weight loss drug.. all except Homer.

episodes.name: P.S. I Hate You
episodes.summary: Marge's "nice-lady" reputation is on the line when an unknown blackmailer threatens to expose the angry woman she is inside.

episodes.name: Abe League of Their Moe
episodes.summary: After Grampa And Moe recruit a Macedonian slugger to play in Springfield, it strains their friendship and the very integrity of baseball.

episodes.name: Stew Lies
episodes.summary: Homer reinvigorates a celebrity chef's lost passion for food -- with some help from the mob.

episodes.name: Full Heart, Empty Pool
episodes.summary: Homer and Grampa team up to create a new sport that rivals pickleball, until Homer kicks Grampa off.

episodes.name: Estranger Things
episodes.summary: When Bart & Lisa stop watching Itchy & Scratchy together, Marge fears that they'll start to drift apart.. but she has no idea how bad things are about to get!.

episodes.name: Thrifty Ways to Thieve Your Mother
episodes.summary: When Lisa starts wearing Marge's "vintage" clothes from the 90's, she's welcomed into the school's super-elite fashion club. But as they run out of retro looks, the funky fashionistas become obsessed with getting more.. by hook or by crook.

episodes.name: Keep Chalm and Gary On
episodes.summary: Homer gets Superintendent Chalmers a job at the power plant. There, Chalmers discovers huge mutated snails that produce valuable slime launching his new career as a man-o-sphere guru.

episodes.name: Treehouse of Horror XXXVI
episodes.summary: In this year's installment of the annual fright-fest, the town is menaced by a mysterious murdering monster from out of the sewers, Krusty has a demonic special guest on his live Halloween special, and we go a thousand years into Springfield's poseable plastic post-apocalyptic future.

episodes.name: Men Behaving Manly
episodes.summary: Springfield's men are in crisis.

episodes.name: Bad Boys... For Life?
episodes.summary: Is Bart Simpson truly a bad seed? Homer and Marge must find out once and for good.

episodes.name: Bart 'N' Frink
episodes.summary: When Bart becomes Professor Frink's lab assistant, the Simpsons are thrown into a world of tech billionaires determined to live forever, with the future of the internet at stake.

episodes.name: Sashes to Sashes
episodes.summary: Bart runs against Mayor Quimby's son for student council president, while Lisa learns troubling secrets about the Quimby clan.. and about the Simpsons.

episodes.name: The Day of the Jack-up
episodes.summary: After a mysterious buyer purchases every ticket for the KPOP concert Lisa wants to go to, the Simpsons have to figure out the identity of this evil ticket reseller. Or do they? (Yes, they do).

episodes.name: Aunt Misbehavin'
episodes.summary: Patty and Bart team up for the ultimate prank: getting Homer declared legally dead. To their chagrin, Homer loves being officially dead - which leads to Patty and Selma having a huge fight and Patty moving away to "Palm Springfield".

episodes.name: Guess Who's Coming to Skinner
episodes.summary: When Principal Skinner discovers that one of his students is a runaway who has been living in the school library, he has to take the snarky, difficult kid into his home and is forced into a role he never expected or wanted - being a parent.

episodes.name: Parahormonal Activity
episodes.summary: Set in the near future, Marge is competently coping with the hormonal onslaught hitting her now teenage kids when she's suddenly struck by a big life change of her own, leaving Homer as the last sane person in the house.. or is he?

episodes.name: ¡The Fall Guy-Yi-Yi!
episodes.summary: Homer revitalizes Bumblebee Man's career when he becomes his secret stuntman. But how much punishment can a Stunt-Bee take before it starts to sting.

episodes.name: Seperance
episodes.summary: Homer's enthusiasm skills land him a job at a secretive company with a mind-altering agenda.

episodes.name: Irrational Treasure
episodes.summary: Marge's crusade to get the family dog in better shape leads to her entering Santa's Little Helper in canine agility competitions and a trip to the National Dog Show in Philadelphia. There, Marge and Homer suddenly find themselves - and the dog - mixed up in a historical conspiracy adventure worthy of a "National Treasure" movie.

episodes.name: Homer? A Cracker Bro?
episodes.summary: Homer strikes up an unlikely friendship with Kirk Van Houten, which leads to them launching a hugely successful business venture together - a "crumbless" cracker that sweeps the nation. But when Kirk's darkest secrets are revealed, Homer has to choose between his family and his fortune... and may just end up going in jail.

episodes.name: The Children's Book Job
episodes.summary: A British children's book author comes to Springfield to give a talk at Springfield Elementary School. Homer is tasked with picking her up from the airport, but things go bad from there.

episodes.name: Diary of a Chimpy Kid
episodes.summary: Bart and Lisa adopt an abandoned baby chimp and clash over their surprisingly different parenting styles. When the chimp is abducted by a private wild animal zoo, the family goes on a mission to rescue him. Homer is conflicted about saving the ape, because he's convinced the chimp will tear off his face and groin.

episodes.name: Treehouse of Horror Presents: The Revengening
episodes.summary: All hell breaks loose on Halloween when a killer comes to Springfield and hacks their way through town. No Simpson is safe from... THE REVENGENING!

episodes.name: Treehouse of Horror XXXVII
episodes.summary: Bart and Lisa are trapped in an abandoned immersive theme park experience.

episodes.name: Testing 1-2-3
episodes.summary: In what she argues is not an attempt to get extra time on tests, Lisa has herself evaluated for three types of neurodiversity.. which remind her of behaviors she's witnessed in Principal Skinner, Comic Boy and Homer. Perhaps these atypical behaviors aren't as atypical as we think.

name: Doctor Who
summary: Adventures across time and space with the time travelling alien and companions.

episodes.name: Rose
episodes.summary: Rose Tyler meets a mysterious stranger called the Doctor, and realises Earth is in danger.

episodes.name: The End of the World
episodes.summary: The Doctor takes Rose on her first voyage through time, to the year five billion and the end of planet Earth.

episodes.name: The Unquiet Dead
episodes.summary: Charles Dickens and the Doctor team up as corpses stalk the streets of Victorian Cardiff.

episodes.name: Aliens of London
episodes.summary: Rose is taken home, but a spaceship crashes in the Thames and London is closed off... Enter the Slitheen!

episodes.name: World War Three
episodes.summary: Time is running out for the Doctor as Downing Street announces mankind's first Interplanetary War.

episodes.name: Dalek
episodes.summary: The Doctor is shattered and Earth is in danger as he and Rose discover the Time Lords' deadliest enemy beneath Utah.

episodes.name: The Long Game
episodes.summary: The Doctor investigates a strange satellite, and Adam's skills as an assistant are tested.

episodes.name: Father's Day
episodes.summary: Rose witnesses the day her father died, but interfering leads to terrible consequences... and sinister creatures!

episodes.name: The Empty Child
episodes.summary: Homeless children in wartime London are terrorised by an unearthly child. Plus we meet a certain Captain Jack...

episodes.name: The Doctor Dances
episodes.summary: 'Are you my mummy?' The Child's plague is spreading throughout wartime London, and it looks like Captain Jack is doomed.

episodes.name: Boom Town
episodes.summary: The Doctor, Rose and Captain Jack discover a Slitheen is behind a plan to build a nuclear power station in Cardiff.

episodes.name: Bad Wolf
episodes.summary: The Doctor, Rose and Captain Jack fight for their lives on board the Game Station, but disaster strikes when the Daleks capture Rose!

episodes.name: The Parting of the Ways
episodes.summary: The Ninth Doctor's final episode is an epic encounter with the Daleks.

episodes.name: New Earth
episodes.summary: The Doctor is summoned to an apparently beautiful 'New Earth' where he and Rose find gruesome secrets inside a luxury hospital.

episodes.name: Tooth and Claw
episodes.summary: Queen Victoria, a werewolf and the birth of Torchwood... The Doctor's trip to Scotland, 1879, could prove fatal...

episodes.name: School Reunion
episodes.summary: The return of Sarah Jane and K-9! The Doctor plus companions old and new fight the bat-like Krillitanes!

episodes.name: The Girl in the Fireplace
episodes.summary: The Doctor is smitten by Madame de Pompadour, but the court at Versailles is under attack from Clockwork killers...

episodes.name: Rise of the Cybermen
episodes.summary: On a parallel Earth where Rose's parents remained together, the Doctor sees a terrifying enemy reborn... The Cybermen are coming!

episodes.name: The Age of Steel
episodes.summary: The Cybermen take control of London and start converting the populace. It looks like even the Doctor is beaten...

episodes.name: The Idiot's Lantern
episodes.summary: A face-stealing alien is rampant in Britain at the time of Queen Elizabeth II's coronation. The Doctor and Rose investigate!

episodes.name: The Impossible Planet
episodes.summary: The Doctor and Rose land in a base on an 'impossible planet'. But the TARDIS is missing, there's a killer in the base, and who are the Ood?

episodes.name: The Satan Pit
episodes.summary: As Rose battles the murderous Ood, the Doctor must grapple with a monster that challenges his every belief: the Beast.

episodes.name: Love & Monsters
episodes.summary: Who is the sinister and mysterious Victor Kennedy, and why is he so keen to find the Doctor?

episodes.name: Fear Her
episodes.summary: London, 2012. The Doctor has brought Rose to see the Olympics, but a little girl unwittingly threatens billions of lives.

episodes.name: Army of Ghosts
episodes.summary: The Cybermen have invaded Earth, but the Doctor and Torchwood are about to confront an even greater threat.

episodes.name: Doomsday
episodes.summary: As the human race is caught in a war between Daleks and Cybermen, the Doctor faces losing Rose.

episodes.name: Smith and Jones
episodes.summary: A Judoon platoon on the moon and a vampiric alien! It's all happening when Martha meets the Doctor.

episodes.name: The Shakespeare Code
episodes.summary: In Elizabethan England, William Shakespeare is under the control of witch-like creatures.

episodes.name: Gridlock
episodes.summary: The Doctor takes Martha to New Earth, where he must battle a powerful old enemy and have a fateful meeting with the Face of Boe...

episodes.name: Daleks in Manhattan
episodes.summary: The Doctor finds his oldest enemies at work on top of the Empire State Building when he and Martha travel to 1930s New York.

episodes.name: Evolution of the Daleks
episodes.summary: As a new Dalek Empire rises in 1930s New York, the Doctor must enter an unholy alliance.

episodes.name: The Lazarus Experiment
episodes.summary: Martha has to save her family from the lunatic schemes of the monstrous Professor Lazarus.
The Doctor and Martha must stop a spaceship from hurtling into the sun. But time and a malevolent alien force are against them.

episodes.name: Human Nature
episodes.summary: A schoolteacher called John Smith dreams of adventures in time and space...

episodes.name: The Family of Blood
episodes.summary: It's 1913, and war comes to England early as the terrifying Family hunt for the Doctor.

episodes.name: Blink
episodes.summary: Only the Doctor can stop the Weeping Angels, but he's lost in time. So Sally Sparrow must fly into action...

episodes.name: Utopia
episodes.summary: Captain Jack Harkness storms back into the Doctor's life, and at the end of the universe, an evil old enemy is waiting...

episodes.name: The Sound of Drums
episodes.summary: Harry Saxon - aka the Master - becomes prime minister, but his dark ambitions reach beyond the stars.

episodes.name: Last of the Time Lords
episodes.summary: Earth has been conquered, the Doctor and Jack are imprisoned and the Master rules supreme. Can Martha Jones save the world?

episodes.name: Partners in Crime
episodes.summary: Donna and the Doctor reunite and must save the lives of millions threatened by a sinister alien... Allons-y!

episodes.name: The Fires of Pompeii
episodes.summary: It's Volcano Day in Pompeii... Can Donna dare the Doctor to change history?

episodes.name: Planet of the Ood
episodes.summary: The Doctor takes Donna to her first alien world, where she finds the human race has developed dark secrets...

episodes.name: The Sontaran Stratagem
episodes.summary: Martha Jones summons the Doctor back to UNIT and modern-day Earth, but an old enemy lies in wait.

episodes.name: The Poison Sky
episodes.summary: As the Sontarans choke the Earth, the Doctor and UNIT battle to keep both Martha and Donna alive.

episodes.name: The Doctor's Daughter
episodes.summary: As the shadows of war loom on the planet Messaline, the Doctor meets the most important woman of his life...

episodes.name: The Unicorn and the Wasp
episodes.summary: In 1926, Agatha Christie disappeared for ten days. Was a giant alien wasp to blame?

episodes.name: Silence in the Library
episodes.summary: The Doctor meets River Song for the first time as he and Donna face the Vashta Nerada!

episodes.name: Forest of the Dead
episodes.summary: As the shadows rise, the Doctor forges an alliance with the mysterious River Song. But can they halt the advance of the Vashta Nerada?

episodes.name: Midnight
episodes.summary: Vacation plans go awry for the Doctor when he joins tourists on a flight over the crystalline planet Midnight, where the passengers encounter a malevolent force.

episodes.name: Turn Left
episodes.summary: What would have happened if the Doctor had died facing the Racnoss? We find a nightmare world as Donna and Rose attempt to stop the approaching Darkness.

episodes.name: The Stolen Earth
episodes.summary: The Earth gets hijacked and relocated by a new Dalek empire, prompting the Doctor's allies--Rose Tyler, Sarah Jane Smith, Capt. Jack Harkness and Martha Jones--to band together while an old enemy lurks behind the scenes.

episodes.name: Journey's End
episodes.summary: Season 4 concludes with the Doctor's companions making a last stand against Davros and the Daleks with the Doctor and the TARDIS both out of commission.

episodes.name: The Eleventh Hour
episodes.summary: The Doctor has regenerated into a brand new man, but danger strikes before he can even recover.

episodes.name: The Beast Below
episodes.summary: The Doctor takes Amy to the distant future where she finds Britain in space. Starship UK houses the future of the British people, as they search the stars for a new home. But as Amy explores, she encounters the terrifying Smilers and learns a deadly truth inside the Voting Booth.

episodes.name: Victory of the Daleks
episodes.summary: The Doctor has been summoned by an old friend, but in the Cabinet War Rooms far below the streets of London, it's his oldest enemy he finds waiting for him.

episodes.name: The Time of Angels
episodes.summary: Don't blink—the Weeping Angels return! The Doctor is recruited by Father Octavian to track the last of the Angels through the terrifying Maze of the Dead. And the mysterious River Song is back in the Doctor's life—but can he trust her?

episodes.name: Flesh and Stone
episodes.summary: No way back, no way up, no way out. Trapped among an army of Weeping Angels the Doctor and his friends must try to escape through the wreckage of a crashed space liner.

episodes.name: The Vampires of Venice
episodes.summary: Desiccated corpses, terror in the canal, and the sinister House of Calvierri—the Doctor takes Amy and Rory for a romantic mini-break.

episodes.name: Amy's Choice
episodes.summary: It's been five years since Amy Pond traveled with the Doctor and when he lands in her garden again, on the eve of the birth of her first child, she finds herself facing a heartbreaking choice.

episodes.name: The Hungry Earth
episodes.summary: 2015: the most ambitious drilling project in history has reached deeper below the Earth's crust than man has ever gone – but now the ground itself is fighting back.

episodes.name: Cold Blood
episodes.summary: It's the most important day in the history of Earth—the dawn of a new age of harmony or the start of its final war.

episodes.name: Vincent and the Doctor
episodes.summary: Terror lurks in the cornfields of Provence, but only a sad and lonely painter can see it.

episodes.name: The Lodger
episodes.summary: There's a house on Aickman road and a staircase that people go up, but never down. To solve the mystery of the man upstairs the Doctor must face his greatest challenge.

episodes.name: The Pandorica Opens
episodes.summary: According to legend, the Pandorica contains the most feared being in all the cosmos, a monster soaked in the blood of a billion galaxies.

episodes.name: The Big Bang
episodes.summary: The Doctor is gone, the Tardis has been destroyed and the universe is collapsing. The only hope for all of reality is a little girl who still believes in stars…

episodes.name: The Impossible Astronaut
episodes.summary: Four envelopes, numbered 2, 3 and 4, each containing a date, time and map reference, unsigned and TARDIS blue. Who sent them? And who received the missing envelope numbered 1?

episodes.name: Day of the Moon
episodes.summary: The Doctor is locked in the perfect prison. Amy, Rory and River Song are being hunted down across America by the FBI. With the help of new friend and FBI-insider, Canton Everett Delaware the Third, they reunite to share their discoveries and memories.

episodes.name: The Curse of the Black Spot
episodes.summary:
The TARDIS is marooned onboard a 17th-century pirate ship whose crew is being attacked by a mysterious and beautiful sea creature, as the time-traveling drama continues.

Becalmed and beset by cabin fever, the pirates have numerous superstitious explanations for the appearance of a mysterious Siren. The Doctor has other ideas but as every plan of escape is thwarted, he must win the trust of the implacable Captain Avery and uncover the truth behind the pirates' supernatural fears—and he must work quickly because some of his friends have already fallen under the Siren's spell …

episodes.name: The Doctor's Wife
episodes.summary:
The Doctor receives a distress signal from an old friend. Could there really be another living Time Lord out there? Hopes raised, he follows the signal to a junkyard planet sitting upon a mysterious asteroid in a Bubble universe, populated by a very strange family. The Doctor, Amy and Rory are given the warmest of welcomes by Auntie, Uncle and Nephew.

But the beautiful and insane Idris greets them in a more unusual fashion—what is she trying to tell the Doctor? As the Doctor investigates, he unwittingly puts his friends in the gravest danger.

episodes.name: The Rebel Flesh
episodes.summary: A solar tsunami sends the TARDIS hurtling towards a futuristic factory on earth where human doppelgangers are used to mine dangerous acid. A second wave hits and the 'Gangers' separate. They can remember every second of their 'originals' life and feel every emotion they've ever experienced.

episodes.name: The Almost People
episodes.summary: As the solar storm rages, Jennifer, a Ganger driven mad by the memories of being 'decommissioned', is seeking revenge. She can remember every excruciating second of every 'execution' and is determined that the humans will pay. She isn't just talking war, she's talking revolution.

episodes.name: A Good Man Goes to War
episodes.summary:
Amy Pond has been kidnapped and the Doctor is raising an army to rescue her. But as he and Rory race across galaxies calling in long-held debts and solemnly-given promises, his enemies are laying a carefully concealed trap.

In her cell in Stormcage, River Song sadly acknowledges that the time has come at last. For this day will mark the Battle of Demons run and the Doctor's darkest hour. Both sides will make their sacrifices and River Song must finally reveal her most closely guarded secret to the Doctor.

episodes.name: Let's Kill Hitler
episodes.summary: In the desperate search for Melody Pond, the Tardis crash lands in 1930s Berlin, bringing the Doctor face-to-face with the greatest war criminal in the Universe. And Hitler. The Doctor must teach his adversaries that time travel has responsibilities—and in so doing, learns a harsh lesson in the cruelest warfare of all.

episodes.name: Night Terrors
episodes.summary: The Doctor receives a distress call from the scariest place in the Universe: a child's bedroom. Terrified of the monsters in his cupboard, George's pleas for help break through the barriers of all time and space. But allaying his fears won't be easy, even for the Doctor. Because George's monsters are real.

episodes.name: The Girl Who Waited
episodes.summary: Amy is trapped in a quarantine facility for victims of an alien plague—a plague that will kill the Doctor in a day. The Doctor can use the Tardis to smash through time and break in, but then Rory is on his own. Can he rescue Amy before she is killed by kindness?

episodes.name: The God Complex
episodes.summary: The Tardis lands in what looks like an ordinary hotel. But the walls move, corridors twist and rooms vanish. There is a room for every visitor that contains their deepest, darkest fears. Fears that will kill them. What lies in the Doctor's room? And when his turn comes, will he welcome death like all the rest?

episodes.name: Closing Time
episodes.summary: In the last few days of his life,the Doctorpays a farewell visit to his old friend Craig and encounters a mystery. People are going missing, a silver rat scuttles in the shadows of a department store and somewhere close by the Cybermen are waiting.

episodes.name: The Wedding of River Song
episodes.summary: As the Doctor makes his final journey to the shores of Lake Silencio in Utah, he knows only one thing can keep the universe safe—his own death.

episodes.name: Asylum of the Daleks
episodes.summary: Kidnapped by his oldest foe, the Doctor is forced on an impossible mission – to a place even the Daleks are too terrified to enter… the Asylum. A planetary prison confining the most terrifying and insane of their kind, the Doctor and the Ponds must find an escape route. But with Amy and Rory's relationship in meltdown, and an army of mad Daleks closing in, it is up to the Doctor to save their lives, as well as the Pond's marriage.

episodes.name: Dinosaurs on a Spaceship
episodes.summary:
An unmanned spaceship hurtles towards certain destruction – unless the Doctorcan save it, and its impossible cargo… of dinosaurs!

By his side a ragtag gang of adventurers; a big game hunter, an Egyptian Queen and a surprised member of the Pond family. But little does the Doctor know there is someone else onboard who will stop at nothing to keep hold of his precious, prehistoric cargo.

episodes.name: A Town Called Mercy
episodes.summary: The Doctor gets a Stetson (and a gun!), and finds himself the reluctant Sheriff of a Western town under siege by a relentless cyborg, who goes by the name of, the Gunslinger. But who is he and what does he want? The answer seems to lie with the mysterious, Kahler-Jex, an alien doctor (yes another one!) whose initial appearance is hiding a dark secret.

episodes.name: The Power of Three
episodes.summary: The Doctor and the Ponds puzzle an unlikely invasion of Earth, as millions of sinister black cubes arrive overnight, almost like presents falling from the sky. But what are they, what's inside them and most importantly, who sent them? With the international community at a loss, it's left to the Doctor to unearth who is behind the mystery.

episodes.name: The Angels Take Manhattan
episodes.summary: The Doctor's heart-breaking farewell to Amy and Rory — a race against time through the streets of Manhattan, as New York's statues come to life around them… With Rory's life in danger, the Doctor and Amy must locate him before it's too late! Luckily, an old friend helps them and guides the way…

episodes.name: The Bells of Saint John
episodes.summary: The Doctor's search for Clara Oswald brings him to modern day London, where wifi is everywhere. Humanity lives in a wifi soup, but something dangerous is lurking in the signals, picking off minds and imprisoning them. As Clara becomes the target of this insidious menace, the Doctor races to save her and the world from an ancient enemy.

episodes.name: The Rings of Akhaten
episodes.summary: Clara wants to see something awesome, so the Doctor whisks her off to the inhabited rings of the planet Akhaten, where the Festival of Offerings is in full swing. Clara meets the young Queen of Years as the pilgrims and natives ready for the ceremony. But something is stirring in the pyramid, and a sacrifice will be demanded.

episodes.name: Cold War
episodes.summary: The Doctor and Clara land on a damaged Russian Submarine in 1983 as it spirals out of control into the ocean depths. An alien creature is loose on board, having escaped from a block of Arctic ice. With tempers flaring and a cargo of nuclear weapons on board, it's not just the crew but the whole of humanity at stake!

episodes.name: Hide
episodes.summary: Clara and the Doctor arrive at Caliburn House, a haunted mansion sat alone on a desolate moor. Within its walls, a ghost hunting Professor and a gifted psychic are searching for the Witch of the Well. Her apparition appears throughout the history of the building, but is she really a ghost? And what is chasing her?

episodes.name: Journey to the Centre of the TARDIS
episodes.summary:
A spaceship salvage team drags the TARDIS on board, sending its systems into meltdown. As the Doctor marshals the motely salvage crew outside, he realizes Clara is still trapped within his malfunctioning ship, pursued by a dangerous group of ossified monsters.

He has just 30 minutes to find Clara and save his TARDIS before it self-destructs.

episodes.name: The Crimson Horror
episodes.summary: There's something very odd about Mrs Gillyflower's Sweetville mill, with its perfectly clean streets and beautiful people. There's something even stranger about the bodies washing up in the river, all bright red and waxy. When the Doctor and Clara go missing, it's up to Vastra, Jenny and Strax to rescue them before they too fall victim to the Crimson Horror!

episodes.name: Nightmare in Silver
episodes.summary:
Hedgewick's World of Wonders was once the greatest theme park in the galaxy, but it's now the dilapidated home to a shabby showman, a chess-playing dwarf and a dysfunctional army platoon.

When the Doctor, Clara, Artie and Angie arrive, the last thing they expect is the re-emergence of one of the Doctor's oldest foes. The Cybermen are back!

episodes.name: The Name of the Doctor
episodes.summary:
Clara is summoned to an impossible conference call, alerting her that the deadly Whisper Men are closing in on Vastra, Jenny and Strax.

Someone is kidnapping the Doctor's friends, leading him toward the one place in all of time and space that he should never go. It's a deadly trap that threatens to unravel his past, present and future…

episodes.name: Deep Breath
episodes.summary: Clara is alone in Victorian London with a man she doesn't know, a dinosaur in the Thames, and a spate of deadly spontaneous combustions. The Doctor has changed. It's time you knew him.

episodes.name: Into the Dalek
episodes.summary: A Dalek fleet surrounds a lone rebel ship, and only the Doctor can help them now… With the Doctor facing his greatest enemy, he needs Clara by his side. Confronted with a decision that could change the Daleks forever he is forced to examine his conscience. Will he find the answer to the question "am I a good man?"

episodes.name: Robot of Sherwood
episodes.summary: When Robots threaten Sherwood forest, the Doctor must join forces with Robin Hood to stop the evil reign of the Sheriff of Nottingham.

episodes.name: Listen
episodes.summary: When ghosts of past and future crowd into their lives, the Doctor and Clara are thrown into an adventure that takes them to the very end of the universe.

episodes.name: Time Heist
episodes.summary: The Doctor turns bank robber when he attempts to break into the most dangerous bank in the Cosmos.

episodes.name: The Caretaker
episodes.summary: The terrifying Skovox Blitzer is ready to destroy all humanity – and worse, any second now, Danny Pink and the Doctor are going to meet.

episodes.name: Kill the Moon
episodes.summary: The Doctor and Clara crash land on the Moon to find a world of horror — a mining base full of corpses, vicious spider-like creatures poised to attack, and a terrible dilemma.

episodes.name: Mummy on the Orient Express
episodes.summary:
The Doctor is on the most beautiful train in history, speeding among the stars of the future. But a deadly creature is stalking the passengers. Once you see the horrifying mummy, you only have 66 seconds to live. No exceptions, no reprieve. As the Doctor races against the clock, he is seen at his deadliest and most ruthless.

Will he work out how to defeat the mummy? Start the clock!

episodes.name: Flatline
episodes.summary: Separated from the Doctor, Clara discovers a new menace from another dimension. But how do you hide when even the walls are no protection? With people to save and the Doctor trapped, Clara comes up against an enemy that exists beyond human perception.

episodes.name: In the Forest of the Night
episodes.summary: One morning in every city and town in the world, the human race wakes up to face the most surprising invasion yet. Everywhere, in every land, a forest has grown overnight and taken back the Earth. It doesn't take the Doctor long to discover that the final days of humanity have arrived…

episodes.name: Dark Water
episodes.summary: In the mysterious world of the Nethersphere, plans have been drawn. Missy is about to come face to face with the Doctor, and an impossible choice is looming… "Death is not an end" promises the sinister organization known only as 3W – but, as the Doctor and Clara discover, you might wish it was.

episodes.name: Death in Heaven
episodes.summary: With Cybermen on the streets of London, old friends unite against old enemies, and the Doctor takes to the air in a startling new role. Can the mighty UNIT contain Missy? As the Doctor faces his greatest challenge, sacrifices must be made before the day is won.

episodes.name: The Magician's Apprentice
episodes.summary: On modern-day Earth, planes freeze in the sky, locked in the time. UNIT turns to Clara for help, and they soon discover the person responsible: Missy, back from the dead. Missy wants their help on a unique quest: find the Doctor.

episodes.name: The Witch's Familiar
episodes.summary: On Skaro, Davros asks the captive Doctor for one last favor before his death. Meanwhile, Clara and Missy attempt reenter the Dalek city.

episodes.name: Under the Lake
episodes.summary: The Doctor and Clara arrive on an underwater base in the year 2119, and discover a base under siege. Ghosts are haunting--and killing--the crew, and the Doctor sets out to determine what they want and where they come from.

episodes.name: Before the Flood
episodes.summary: The Doctor travels back to 1980 with Bennett and O'Donnell to try and stop the Fisher King from sending the message that dooms the base in the future. Meanwhile, in the future, Clara, Lunn, and Cass fight to survive the ghosts and discover that their enemies have expanded their ranks.

episodes.name: The Girl Who Died
episodes.summary: The Doctor and Clara are captured by 10th century Vikings, only to discover that alien warriors are abducting the village fighters and harvesting their adrenaline. A young woman challenges the aliens to war, and the remaining villages turn to the Doctor for help.

episodes.name: The Woman Who Lived
episodes.summary: The Doctor travels to England 1651 to find an alien artifact. What he finds instead is an old acquaintance, who he must help answer an age-old question: who wants to live forever?

episodes.name: The Zygon Invasion
episodes.summary: The Doctor and UNIT learn that the Zygon-Human truce has been broken, as a renegade faction of Zygons seek to conquer the world so that they can live in their true forms. Meanwhile, Clara witnesses a strange occurrence outside of her flat.

episodes.name: The Zygon Inversion
episodes.summary: After the Presidential Airliner is destroyed, the Doctor and Osgood head back to London. Meanwhile, Clara discovers that she has been replaced, and the Zygon calling itself Bonnie sets out to recover the Osgood Box from the Black Archive.

episodes.name: Sleep No More
episodes.summary: The Doctor and Clara find themselves aboard the Le Verrier Space Station in orbit above Triton in the 38th century, and face a deadly threat that could consume all of humanity.

episodes.name: Face The Raven
episodes.summary: Rigsy wakes up one day and finds a tattoo on his neck counting down the minutes to zero. He calls Clara's emergency number for help, and the Doctor and Clara soon discover that Rigsy is bait in a trap... but it catches the wrong person.

episodes.name: Heaven Sent
episodes.summary: The Doctor finds himself trapped and alone in an inescapable castle, stalked by an enemy that can't be fought. If he doesn't solve the puzzle of his captivity, then he will never leave.

episodes.name: Hell Bent
episodes.summary: The Doctor bargains with the Time Lords: his knowledge of the Hybrid in return for their saving Clara from death. However, the price may be far more than the Doctor is willing to pay.

episodes.name: The Pilot
episodes.summary: A young woman, Bill, listens to the lectures of a long-time university professor, the Doctor. He soon agrees to tutor her, and Bill realizes that the Doctor is much more than he seems. Bill's mind is opened to a universe that is bigger and more exciting than she could imagine.

episodes.name: Smile
episodes.summary: For her first proper trip, the Doctor takes Bill to a colony in the future. They discover that the skeleton crew has been wiped out, and a terrible fate awaits the awakening colonists unless they do something.

episodes.name: Thin Ice
episodes.summary: The Doctor takes Bill to the Great Frost Fair on the Thames in 1814... and they discover that something is living beneath the ice. Something huge, and hungry.

episodes.name: Knock Knock
episodes.summary: Bill and her mates receive an offer to move into an old house at a price they can't refuse. However, they soon discover that the price is much higher than promised.

episodes.name: Oxygen
episodes.summary: The Doctor takes Bill and Nardole to a space station in the future in response to a distress call. They discover that 36 of the 40 crew members are dead... but their suits aren't.

episodes.name: Extremis
episodes.summary: The Pope asks the Doctor to investigate the mysteries of Veritas, a book that has caused everyone to read it to commit suicide. However, the Doctor soon learns that Veritas contains the real history of the universe… and it is enough to drive anyone to suicide.

episodes.name: The Pyramid at the End of the World
episodes.summary: The Monks materialize a 5,000-year-old pyramid as a threat, and then demand the consent of Earth's leaders to save the planet from imminent destruction.

episodes.name: The Lie of the Land
episodes.summary: Bill finds herself in a world that is ruled by the Monks, and has always believed that the Monks have been there to guide humanity and defend it. Worse, the Doctor is working with the Monks to solidify their rule.

episodes.name: Empress of Mars
episodes.summary: The Doctor and Bill end up stranded on Mars investigating how a 19th century message appeared on the 21st century Mars. They find Victorian soldiers... invading an ancient Ice Warrior hive.

episodes.name: The Eaters of Light
episodes.summary: The Doctor, Bill, and Nardole travel to Scotland in the distant past to learn what happened to the Ninth Legion. They soon discover an alien creature stalking the woods, and the gate that must remain guarded no matter what.

episodes.name: World Enough and Time
episodes.summary: The Doctor decides to test Missy's reformation with a mission to investigate a distress signal coming from a 400-mile-long ship near a black hole. However, things soon take a turn for the worst and an old friend returns with new allies.

episodes.name: The Doctor Falls
episodes.summary: The Doctor rescues Bill, but warns her that there's no going back to the way things were. Meanwhile, the Cybermen prepare to invade another floor of the spaceship, and Missy must choose sides.

episodes.name: The Woman Who Fell to Earth
episodes.summary: In a South Yorkshire city, Ryan Sinclair, Yasmin Khan, and Graham O'Brien are about to have their lives changed forever, as a mysterious woman, unable to remember her own name, falls from the night sky. Can they believe a word she says? Ryan stumbles across a mysterious pod that appears in the forest. Soon a series of strange occurrences happen in Sheffield, and the mysterious woman sets out to solve them.

episodes.name: The Ghost Monument
episodes.summary: The Doctor and her new friends are rescued by two separate spaceships on a mysterious quest, and at the end of the quest lies... the Ghost Monument.

episodes.name: Rosa
episodes.summary: The Doctor and her friends find themselves in the Deep South of America when they arrive in Montgomery, Alabama, in 1955. As they encounter a seamstress named Rosa Parks, they begin to wonder if someone is attempting to change history. They discover that a criminal from the future is trying to alter time and make sure that Rosa is never forced to stand on the bus.

episodes.name: Arachnids in the UK
episodes.summary: The Doctor and her companions return to Earth and find a homegrown menace in the apartment complex where Yasmin's family live... and at the hotel where her mother Najia works.

episodes.name: The Tsuranga Conundrum
episodes.summary: After a sonic mine detonates, injuring them, the TARDIS crew wake up on a medical ship. They soon discover that they're trapped with an omnivore that threatens the ship's integrity... and the authorities will blow up the ship rather than let the creature endanger thousands of patients.

episodes.name: Demons of the Punjab
episodes.summary: Yasmin asks the Doctor to travel back to 1947 India to find out the secret of her grandmother's watch, and discovers more than she wanted to know.

episodes.name: Kerblam!
episodes.summary: After receiving an anonymous request for help, the Doctor and her companions travel to a moon of Kandoka to investigate the universe's large retailer: Kerblam.

episodes.name: The Witchfinders
episodes.summary: The Doctor and her companions materialize in 17th century England and soon find themselves embroiled in local witchcraft... which is the prelude to an alien invasion.

episodes.name: It Takes You Away
episodes.summary: The TARDIS group materialize in Norway in 2018, and soon find themselves involved with a blind girl and her missing father.

episodes.name: The Battle of Ranskoor Av Kolos
episodes.summary: The Doctor and her companions respond to nine separate distress signals all originating from the same planet: Ranskoor Av Kolos. There they discover a stranded ship, an amnesiac pilot... and an old foe.

episodes.name: Spyfall, Part 1
episodes.summary: Intelligence agents around the world are under attack from alien forces, so MI6 turns to the only people who can help - The Doctor and friends. As the team travels the globe looking for answers, attacks come from all sides. Earth's security rests on the their shoulders - but where will this planet-threatening conspiracy lead them?

episodes.name: Spyfall, Part 2
episodes.summary: A terrifying plan to destroy humanity is about to reach fruition. Can the Doctor and her companions escape multiple traps and defeat a deadly alliance?

episodes.name: Orphan 55
episodes.summary: Having decided that everyone could do with a holiday, the Doctor takes Graham, Yasmin, Ryan to a luxury resort for a spot of rest and relaxation. However, they discover the place where they are having a break is hiding a number of deadly secrets. What are the ferocious monsters that are attacking Tranquillity Spa?

episodes.name: Nikola Tesla's Night of Terror
episodes.summary: It is 1903 and on the edge of Niagara Falls, something is wrong at Nikola Tesla's generator plant, where someone – or something – is sabotaging the maverick inventor's work. Has Tesla really received a message from Mars? And where does his great rival Thomas Edison fit into these events? The Doctor and her companions Yaz, Ryan and Graham must join forces with one of history's greatest minds to save both him and planet Earth.

episodes.name: Fugitive of the Judoon
episodes.summary: Stomping their way into present-day Gloucester, the Judoon are on the hunt for someone on the run. Who is this fugitive? And why are these alien mercenaries after them?

episodes.name: Praxeus
episodes.summary: What connects a missing astronaut, birds behaving strangely in Peru, and a US naval officer who washes up on a Madagascan beach? The Doctor, Yaz, Ryan and Graham split up to investigate mysterious events across 21st century planet Earth. As the mystery deepens, and lives are put at risk, the TARDIS team face a deadly race against time to save humanity.

episodes.name: Can You Hear Me?
episodes.summary: From ancient Syria to present day Sheffield, and out into the wilds of space, something is stalking the Doctor and her friends and infecting people's nightmares. As Graham, Yaz and Ryan return home to see friends and family, they find themselves haunted by very different experiences. Who is the figure calling from beyond the stars for help, and why? And what are the fearsome Chagaskas terrorising Aleppo in 1380? To find the answers, Team TARDIS embark on a mission that forces them to face their darkest fears.

episodes.name: The Haunting of Villa Diodati
episodes.summary: The Doctor and gang arrive at the Villa Diodati, Lake Geneva, in 1816 - on a night that inspired Mary Shelley's Frankenstein. The plan is to spend the evening soaking up the atmos in the presence of some literary greats - but the ghosts are all too real. And the Doctor is forced into a decision of earth-shattering proportions…

episodes.name: Ascension of the Cybermen
episodes.summary: The aftermath of the Great CyberWar. The Doctor arrives in the far future, intent on protecting the last of the human race from the deadly Cybermen. But in the face of such a relentless enemy, has she put her best friends at risk? What terrors lie hiding in the depths of space, and what is Ko Sharmus?

episodes.name: The Timeless Children
episodes.summary: The Cybermen attack, and for the Doctor nothing will ever be the same.

episodes.name: Chapter One: The Halloween Apocalypse
episodes.summary: On Halloween, all across the universe, terrifying forces are stirring. From the Arctic Circle to deep space, an ancient evil is breaking free. And in present-day Liverpool, the life of Dan Lewis is about to change forever. Why is the Doctor on the trail of the fearsome Karvanista? And what is the Flux?

episodes.name: Chapter Two: War of the Sontarans
episodes.summary: During the Crimean War, the Doctor discovers the British army fighting a brutal alien army of Sontarans, as Yaz and Dan are thrown deeper into a battle for survival. What is the Temple of Atropos? Who are the Mouri?

episodes.name: Chapter Three: Once, Upon Time
episodes.summary: On a planet that shouldn't exist, in the aftermath of apocalypse, the Doctor, Dan, Yaz and Vinder face a battle to survive.

episodes.name: Chapter Four: Village of the Angels
episodes.summary: Devon, November 1967. A little girl has gone missing, Professor Eustacius Jericho is conducting psychic experiments, and in the village graveyard, there is one gravestone too many. Why is Medderton known as the Cursed Village, and what do the Weeping Angels want?

episodes.name: Chapter Five: Survivors of the Flux
episodes.summary: As the forces of evil mass, the Doctor, Yaz and Dan face perilous journeys and seemingly insurmountable obstacles in their quest for survival.

episodes.name: Chapter Six: The Vanquishers
episodes.summary: In the final epic chapter in the story of the Flux, all hope is lost. The forces of darkness are in control. But when the monsters have won, who can you count upon to save the universe?

name: Friends
summary:
Six young (20-something) people from New York City (Manhattan), on their own and struggling to survive in the real world, find the companionship, comfort and support they get from each other to be the perfect antidote to the pressures of life.

This average group of buddies goes through massive mayhem, family trouble, past and future romances, fights, laughs, tears and surprises as they learn what it really means to be a friend.

episodes.name: The One Where Monica Gets a Roommate
episodes.summary: Monica's old friend Rachel moves in with her after leaving her fiancé.

episodes.name: The One With the Sonogram at the End
episodes.summary: Rachel returns her engagement ring; Ross's ex-wife has a revelation for him.

episodes.name: The One With the Thumb
episodes.summary: Monica's friends find her new beau appealing; Phoebe finds a little something extra in her soda.

episodes.name: The One With George Stephanopoulos
episodes.summary: Chandler and Joey take Ross to a hockey game -- with painful results; the ladies get someone else's pizza.

episodes.name: The One With the East German Laundry Detergent
episodes.summary: Ross does laundry with Rachel; Joey uses Monica to get his old girlfriend back.

episodes.name: The One With the Butt
episodes.summary: Joey's new agent gets him a cheeky role in a movie; Chandler dates a woman with lots of baggage.

episodes.name: The One With the Blackout
episodes.summary: A blackout traps Chandler in an ATM vestibule with model Jill Goodacre; a cat comes between Ross and Rachel.

episodes.name: The One Where Nana Dies Twice
episodes.summary: Monica and Ross mourn the loss of their grandmother.

episodes.name: The One Where Underdog Gets Away
episodes.summary: Monica tries to cook Thanksgiving dinner for the gang; Ross relishes the chance to talk to his unborn child.

episodes.name: The One With the Monkey
episodes.summary: A new pet monkeys around with Ross's ego during the holidays; Phoebe falls for a scientist .

episodes.name: The One With Mrs. Bing
episodes.summary: Chandler's novelist mother visits -- and hits on Ross; Phoebe and Monica fall for the same guy.

episodes.name: The One With the Dozen Lasagnas
episodes.summary: Phoebe has some bad news for Rachel about Paolo; Ross learns some of the results of his former wife's amniocentesis.

episodes.name: The One With the Boobies
episodes.summary: Chandler sees Rachel naked; Joey learns his father is having an affair; Phoebe dates a psychiatrist.

episodes.name: The One With the Candy Hearts
episodes.summary: Chandler has a blind date with an ex-girlfriend -- whom he's broken up with twice before; the ladies light a "boyfriend bonfire"; Ross finds an unlikely Valentine's Day date.

episodes.name: The One With the Stoned Guy
episodes.summary: Chandler and Monica plan big career moves, while Ross labors to hit it off with a date.

episodes.name: The One With Two Parts, Part 1
episodes.summary: Ross attends Lamaze classes; Joey dates Phoebe's twin; and Chandler has the hots for a co-worker he's supposed to fire.

episodes.name: The One With Two Parts, Part 2
episodes.summary: Monica and Rachel meet two cute doctors; Ross looks to Jack for fatherly advice; Phoebe confronts her twin about Joey.

episodes.name: The One With All the Poker
episodes.summary: The guys let the ladies in on a sacred ritual -- their poker game. Meanwhile, Rachel has an interview with Saks.

episodes.name: The One Where the Monkey Gets Away
episodes.summary: Ross entrusts Rachel with his pet monkey for a day; Barry has a surprise for Rachel.

episodes.name: The One With the Evil Orthodontist
episodes.summary: Chandler's not a very smooth operator when it comes to calling a woman he went out with; Rachel gets involved with her ex-fiancé.

episodes.name: The One With the Fake Monica
episodes.summary: Monica meets the woman who used her credit-card number; Ross realizes it's time to find a new home for Marcel.

episodes.name: The One With the Ick Factor
episodes.summary: Phoebe gets temporary work as Chandler's secretary; Monica's new boyfriend is younger than she thinks.

episodes.name: The One With the Birth
episodes.summary: Ross quarrels with Susan in the delivery room as Carol prepares to give birth; Joey befriends a mother-to-be.

episodes.name: The One Where Rachel Finds Out
episodes.summary: Rachel finally realizes how much Ross likes her -- but not before he leaves for China on museum business.

episodes.name: The One With Ross's New Girlfriend
episodes.summary: Rachel meets Ross's female travel companion; Joey unwittingly recommends a seamy tailor to Chandler; and Phoebe cuts Monica's hair.

episodes.name: The One With the Breast Milk
episodes.summary: Monica goes shopping with Julie behind Rachel's back; Ross isn't exactly gaga over breast milk.

episodes.name: The One Where Heckles Dies
episodes.summary: The gang disturbs Mr. Heckles for the last time; Phoebe takes issue with Ross on the subject of evolution.

episodes.name: The One With Phoebe's Husband
episodes.summary: Phoebe's secret husband shows up; Rachel tries to distract Ross from having sex with Julie.

episodes.name: The One With Five Steaks and an Eggplant
episodes.summary: Chandler receives a sexy phone call meant for someone else; the gang becomes divided along income lines.

episodes.name: The One With the Baby on the Bus
episodes.summary: An allergic reaction sends Ross to the hospital, leaving Chandler and Joey to look after Ben; Central Perk hires another singer to replace Phoebe.

episodes.name: The One Where Ross Finds Out
episodes.summary: Rachel goes on a date in an effort to forget about Ross; Monica presses Chandler to complete an exercise program.

episodes.name: The One With the List
episodes.summary: Ross is torn between Rachel and Julie, so Chandler prompts him to list each woman's pros and cons; Monica concocts recipes for a new product.

episodes.name: The One With Phoebe's Dad
episodes.summary: Phoebe confronts her grandmother about the father she never knew; things heat up at Monica's holiday party.

episodes.name: The One With Russ
episodes.summary: Rachel dates a guy who's similar to Ross; Joey can get a part if he sleeps with the casting director; Fun Bobby is no fun without alcohol.

episodes.name: The One With the Lesbian Wedding
episodes.summary: Rachel's mother considers ending her marriage; Carol decides to marry her lover, Susan; Phoebe believes she's possessed.

episodes.name: The One After the Superbowl, Part 1
episodes.summary: Ross searches for Marcel; Joey is attracted to an obsessed fan; Phoebe sings songs for kids.

episodes.name: The One After the Superbowl, Part 2
episodes.summary: Ross learns Marcel is working on a movie, and the film's makeup artist seems to want Chandler; Monica and Rachel fight over Jean-Claude Van Damme, who appears as himself.

episodes.name: The One With the Prom Video
episodes.summary: Monica brings some things home from her parents' house, including a prom video; Rachel tells Ross that she doesn't think it will work out between them.

episodes.name: The One Where Ross and Rachel... You Know
episodes.summary: Ross's work hinders the evolution of his and Rachel's romance; Monica has eyes for an older opthalmologist; Joey and Chandler enjoy a big-screen TV.

episodes.name: The One Where Joey Moves Out
episodes.summary: Richard's relationship with a younger woman causes a stir at a party for Ross and Monica's dad; Joey decides to move out; Rachel gets a tattoo.

episodes.name: The One Where Eddie Moves In
episodes.summary: Chandler gets a new roommate; Monica doesn't like having Ross around all the time; Phoebe makes a music video.

episodes.name: The One Where Dr. Ramoray Dies
episodes.summary: The days in the life of Joey's character, Dr. Ramoray, are numbered; Chandler's new roommate scares him.

episodes.name: The One Where Eddie Won't Go
episodes.summary: Chandler wants Eddie to move out; Joey faces unemployment; a self-help book empowers the ladies.

episodes.name: The One Where Old Yeller Dies
episodes.summary: Rachel freaks when Ross talks about spending a lifetime together; Chandler and Joey befriend Richard; Phoebe is shocked by the ending of "Old Yeller."

episodes.name: The One With the Bullies
episodes.summary: Bullies accost Ross and Chandler; Monica plays the stock market; and Phoebe attempts to meet her father again.

episodes.name: The One With the Two Parties
episodes.summary: When Rachel's divorcing parents both show up for her birthday, her friends hold two separate parties to keep them apart.

episodes.name: The One With the Chicken Pox
episodes.summary: A submariner surfaces to spend two weeks with Phoebe, who's come down with chicken pox; Joey plays the role of a data processor at Chandler's company.

episodes.name: The One With Barry and Mindy's Wedding
episodes.summary: Rachel's in her ex-fiancé's wedding; Chandler has a cyberspace romance; Monica and Richard think about their future.

episodes.name: The One With the Princess Leia Fantasy
episodes.summary: Janice tries to change Joey's opinion of her; Ross's sexual fantasy isn't kept between him and Rachel; Monica can't shake memories of Richard.

episodes.name: The One Where No One's Ready
episodes.summary: Nobody seems to be getting the message when Ross demands that the group get ready for his black-tie benefit.

episodes.name: The One With the Jam
episodes.summary: Monica turns her attention from making jam to maybe making a baby; Phoebe befriends a guy who's stalking her twin sister.

episodes.name: The One With the Metaphorical Tunnel
episodes.summary: Chandler decides to make a real commitment to Janice; Phoebe poses as Joey's agent; Ross is troubled by Ben's toy.

episodes.name: The One With Frank Jr.
episodes.summary: The gang compiles "freebie lists"; Phoebe tries to get to know her half brother; Joey builds an entertainment center.

episodes.name: The One With the Flashback
episodes.summary: The show flashes back to when the friends were acquaintances and pairing off was a possibility.

episodes.name: The One With the Race Car Bed
episodes.summary: Monica orders a bed from the store owned by Janice's estranged husband; Joey teaches soap-opera acting; Ross struggles through a dinner with Rachel's abrasive father.

episodes.name: The One With the Giant Poking Device
episodes.summary: Joey reveals to Chandler that he saw Janice kissing her estranged husband; Rachel and Monica baby-sit Ben; Phoebe explains her fear of the dentist.

episodes.name: The One With the Football
episodes.summary: Ross and Monica go nose-to-nose in an unfriendly Thanksgiving football game.

episodes.name: The One Where Rachel Quits
episodes.summary: Rachel quits Central Perk; Phoebe objects to the treatment of Christmas trees; Ross sells cookies for a "Brown Bird" scout he injured; Monica gets hooked on Mint Treasures.

episodes.name: The One Where Chandler Can't Remember Which Sister
episodes.summary: A drunken Chandler has a liaison with one of Joey's sisters; a nice guy recommends Rachel for a job.

episodes.name: The One With All the Jealousy
episodes.summary: Ross is jealous of Mark; a romantic poet criticizes Monica in verse; Joey's a dancing fool for a Broadway musical audition.

episodes.name: The One Where Monica and Richard are Just Friends
episodes.summary: Monica sees Richard again and they agree to be just pals -- and occasional lovers; Phoebe's new beau has an embarrassing habit.

episodes.name: The One With Phoebe's Ex-Partner
episodes.summary: Phoebe's ex-singing partner wants to reunite; Chandler likes a woman associated with a shameful incident from Joey's past; Ross wants to spend more time with Rachel.

episodes.name: The One Where Ross and Rachel Take a Break
episodes.summary: Ross and Rachel decide to take a break in their relationship; Phoebe dates a diplomat who requires a translator.

episodes.name: The One the Morning After
episodes.summary: Ross's fling with Chloe jeopardizes his future with Rachel, who learns of the misdeed after she says she wants to work things out.

episodes.name: The One Without the Ski Trip
episodes.summary: Rachel organizes a ski trip for all the friends except Ross, who must then come to their rescue when they run out of gas.

episodes.name: The One With the Hypnosis Tape
episodes.summary: Phoebe's upset by her brother's engagement to an older woman; Monica dates a computer-software mogul; Chandler tries to quit smoking.

episodes.name: The One With the Tiny T-Shirt
episodes.summary: Mark asks out Rachel, who returns Ross's things; Monica still isn't attracted to millionaire Pete; Joey's irked by his costar in a play.

episodes.name: The One With the Dollhouse
episodes.summary: Chandler's insincere "I'll call you" to Rachel's boss causes complications; Monica inherits a dollhouse; Joey and Kate get romantic.

episodes.name: The One With a Chick and a Duck
episodes.summary: Ross helps an injured Rachel prepare for a business dinner, but doesn't tell her he's missing a chance to appear on TV; Pete buys Monica a restaurant; Chandler and Joey adopt a baby chick.

episodes.name: The One With the Screamer
episodes.summary: The gang goes to the opening night of Joey's play and Rachel brings a date to make Ross jealous; Phoebe waits on hold so she can have her phone repaired before the warranty expires.

episodes.name: The One With Ross's Thing
episodes.summary: Ross has an unusual growth; Phoebe is torn between two men she's dating; Monica thinks Pete is going to propose.

episodes.name: The One With the Ultimate Fighting Champion
episodes.summary: Pete pursues the Ultimate Fighting championship; Chandler has a slap-happy new boss; Ross dates Phoebe's friend.

episodes.name: The One at the Beach
episodes.summary: Phoebe's quest to find her father leads the gang to a beach house -- and leads Phoebe to a fateful meeting with an old family friend; Rachel persuades Bonnie to make a change.

episodes.name: The One With the Jellyfish
episodes.summary: At the beach house, Ross and Rachel appear on the threshold of a new era; Phoebe gets to know her birth mother; Monica is stung by a jellyfish.

episodes.name: The One With the Cat
episodes.summary: Phoebe thinks her mother's spirit resides in a cat; Monica dates a former high-school hunk; Joey tries to sell the entertainment center.

episodes.name: The One With the 'Cuffs
episodes.summary: Chandler's torrid fling with Rachel's boss puts him in a compromising position; Monica caters her mom's party.

episodes.name: The One With the Ballroom Dancing
episodes.summary: Joey' s roped into being the superintendent's practice dance partner; Phoebe gets fired.

episodes.name: The One With Joey's New Girlfriend
episodes.summary: Chandler falls for Joey's new girlfriend; Phoebe likes the effect of a cold on her singing voice.

episodes.name: The One With the Dirty Girl
episodes.summary: Phoebe helps Monica cater a funeral; Chandler buys Kathy a special birthday gift; Ross's beautiful date has a very messy place.

episodes.name: The One Where Chandler Crosses the Line
episodes.summary: Chandler keeps Kathy company while Joey's out with another girl---and one thing leads to another.

episodes.name: The One With Chandler in a Box
episodes.summary: On Thanksgiving, Chandler begs for Joey's forgiveness about Kathy; Monica has eyes for Richard's son.

episodes.name: The One Where They're Going to Party!
episodes.summary: Rachel is promised a promotion; a restaurateur confronts Monica after she writes a scathing review; Chandler and Ross prepare to party with a world-class carouser.

episodes.name: The One With the Girl from Poughkeepsie
episodes.summary: Monica hires Joey so she can fire him to show who's the boss at the restaurant; Ross goes extra miles to date a gal from Poughkeepsie; Chandler plays matchmaker for Rachel.

episodes.name: The One With Phoebe's Uterus
episodes.summary: In lieu of a gift, newlyweds Frank Jr. and Alice ask Phoebe to be a surrogate mother for their child; Ross breaks an unwritten rule at the museum.

episodes.name: The One With the Embryos
episodes.summary: Phoebe undergoes in-vitro fertilization; Monica and Rachel go up against Joey and Chandler to determine which pair know the other better.

episodes.name: The One With Rachel's Crush
episodes.summary: Kathy's sexy role in a play irks Chandler; personal-shopper Rachel develops a crush on a client.

episodes.name: The One With Joey's Dirty Day
episodes.summary: Joey doesn't smell too good when he's about to appear in a Charlton Heston movie; Rachel asks Ross to entertain her boss's niece so she can be with Joshua; the girls join heartbroken Chandler at a strip joint.

episodes.name: The One With All the Rugby
episodes.summary: Ross plays rugby to impress Emily; to escape Janice, Chandler claims he's being transferred; Monica obsesses over a useless switch.

episodes.name: The One With the Fake Party
episodes.summary: Rachel throws an impromptu going-away party for Emily to lure Joshua into a social setting; pregnant vegetarian Phoebe craves meat.

episodes.name: The One With the Free Porn
episodes.summary: Ross pursues his romance with Emily; Phoebe learns she's having triplets; the boys get free adult TV.

episodes.name: The One With Rachel's New Dress
episodes.summary: Rachel gears up for a night of romance with Joshua; Ross fears Emily is getting too chummy with Susan; Phoebe names one of the triplets.

episodes.name: The One With All the Haste
episodes.summary: Ross proposes to Emily; Rachel and Monica demand their apartment back from the guys.

episodes.name: The One With All the Wedding Dresses
episodes.summary: Monica tries on Emily's wedding dress; Ross's plans affect Rachel and Joshua; Chandler insists Joey get help for his snoring.

episodes.name: The One With the Invitation
